newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee strengthened on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee strengthened on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both the dollar and the pound on Monday, commercial banks forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 20.242 for one dollar on Monday from 20.329 last Friday. The rupee firmed to a mean of 31.513 against the pound on Monday from 31.533 on Friday.
Money dealers attributed the strengthening rupee to the dollar's late Friday's weakening in international markets.
